name: Shadowthread Cave
summary: Shadowthread Cave is a damp cavern carved into the northwest cliffs of Shadowglen on Teldrassil. Traditionally inhabited by indigenous Webwood spiders, the cave has recently turned dangerously aggressive under the dominion of their broodmother, Githyiss the Vile.

sections.title: A Brood Growing Restless
sections.body: Tucked away in the shaded perimeter of Shadowglen, Shadowthread Cave has long served as a natural lair for Teldrassil's giant spiders. In earlier years, these arachnids coexisted quietly alongside the nascent boughs of the World Tree. Recently, however, their temperament has turned fiercely territorial. Thick layers of webwood silk now choke the stone corridors, and the aggressive nature of the brood poses an immediate hazard to young kaldorei taking their first steps beyond Aldrassil.

sections.title: Githyiss the Vile
sections.body: The primary menace lurking deep within the cave's darkest recesses is Githyiss the Vile, a monstrous broodmother whose ferocity far outstrips the common webwood crawlers. Novice night elf sentinels and druids are dispatched to the cave to curb the spider infestation and slay Githyiss, ensuring that the corruption touching Teldrassil's wildlife does not overrun the sanctuary of Shadowglen entirely.

faq.answer: Shadowthread Cave lies in the northwest corner of Shadowglen, nestled against the rocky hillside bordering the night elf starting valley in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are the spiders in the cave so aggressive?
faq.answer: While spiders have always dwelled within the cave, a foul sickness and growing imbalance across Teldrassil has driven the local wildlife mad, turning the webwood spiders exceptionally violent.

Githyiss the Vile is a massive, venomous webwood spider matriarch nestled at the deepest point of Shadowthread Cave. She is the mother of the aggressive brood threatening young kaldorei in Shadowglen.

faq.q: What makes the cave valuable despite the danger?
faq.answer: The cave is packed with layers of dense, naturally spun webwood silk, a valuable and resilient crafting material woven by the endless swarms of arachnids inhabiting its dark chambers.

angles.text: For young night elves, clearing Shadowthread Cave and slaying Githyiss the Vile serves as one of their very first trials in defending their sacred home from creeping corruption.
The unchecked aggression of the Webwood brood in Shadowthread Cave is a troubling indicator to druids that the natural harmony of Teldrassil is deeply disturbed.
